## Privacy and security

- [ ] No real clipboard content, credentials, keys, private paths, dumps, or user data are included.
- [ ] Privacy admission, authentication, authorization, retention, and logging boundaries are unchanged or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] New unsafe/native behavior documents ownership, lifetime, and failure invariants.
